Our mission

Since 2022, more than $238 billion* has been set aside for consumers and businesses.

Because most businesses never file, we’ve made it our mission to help you collect the funds you’re entitled to by simplifying the settlement recovery process.

*Source: Law.com

What we do

At Collectively we are revolutionizing the way businesses file and collect in antitrust and class action settlements. Once you’ve registered, it can be as easy as 1, 2, 3.

  1. 1. We match

    you with new settlements that you could be eligible for.

  2. 2. We file

    on your behalf and keep you updated every step of the way.

  3. 3. You collect

    the money you’re entitled to.

Pricing options: No up-front cost, Premium plans and save more with annual discounts.
